title: Getting started with the weaviate store with config entries

cues.en: So we have the Weaviate dependency installed, and we have Weaviate up and running.
cues.zh: Weaviate 相依套件已安裝，服務也已啟動。

cues.en: Now, we want to get started implementing the actual store for Weaviate.
cues.zh: 現在要開始實作真正的 Weaviate 儲存區，

cues.en: But of course, there's some configuration things that we need to have first.
cues.zh: 不過當然先需要一些設定，

cues.en: So these are pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 這些都非常直接。

cues.en: Let's go over to config.py.
cues.zh: 到 config.py，

cues.en: In class config, I'm going to add some additional information right here, four new fields.
cues.zh: 在 Config 類別新增一些資訊，總共四個欄位。

cues.en: We need, where's the Weaviate host?
cues.zh: 首先需要知道 Weaviate 主機在哪裡，

cues.en: Just like we need to know where Postgres is running, we need to know where Weaviate is running.
cues.zh: 就像必須知道 Postgres 跑在哪裡，也得知道 Weaviate 的位置。

cues.en: So Weaviate host, that's just going to be a string, okay?
cues.zh: 所以 weaviate_host 的型別就是 str。

cues.en: We also need to know what port it's listening on, Weaviate underscore HTTP underscore port, okay?
cues.zh: 另外要知道它監聽哪個連接埠，也就是 weaviate_http_port，

cues.en: That's one way you can talk to, try that again, underscore port.
cues.zh: 這是一種連接方式，重新輸入一下，結尾是 _port，

cues.en: That's one way you can talk to Weaviate.
cues.zh: 這是與 Weaviate 溝通的其中一種方式。

cues.en: That's going to be an integer.
cues.zh: 型別是 int。

cues.en: And we need to know where its gRPC port is.
cues.zh: 還需要知道 gRPC 的連接埠，

cues.en: And that's one of the big advantages of Weaviate, I suppose, I must confess, even though I tend to use Postgres myself, it does use gRPC.
cues.zh: 我得承認這大概是 Weaviate 的主要優勢之一，雖然自己比較常用 Postgres，但 Weaviate 支援 gRPC。

cues.en: So if you need to do a lot of batch actions, for example, it's faster to send it over gRPC.
cues.zh: 例如需要大量批次操作時，透過 gRPC 傳送比較快。

cues.en: So we'll put this value in here, Weaviate underscore gRPC underscore port.
cues.zh: 所以加入 weaviate_grpc_port，

cues.en: And that's also going to be an integer.
cues.zh: 同樣是整數。

cues.en: And there's one more we need.
cues.zh: 另外還需要一項，

cues.en: We need to know the Weaviate collection.
cues.zh: 就是 Weaviate collection，

cues.en: This would be analogous to the database name in Postgres, and the Weaviate collection is just a string, okay?
cues.zh: 它類似 Postgres 的資料庫名稱，weaviate_collection 只是一個字串。

cues.en: Now, of course, we need to come down here to load config and do something with those values.
cues.zh: 當然還要到 load_config，真正設定這些值。

cues.en: So I'll just put them at the end, okay?
cues.zh: 我就放在最後，

cues.en: You can put them anywhere you want, as long as it's in this return config area.
cues.zh: 只要在 return Config 這個區域裡，放哪裡都可以。

cues.en: I'll put in, well, Weaviate host is the first one, Weaviate underscore host.
cues.zh: 第一項是 weaviate_host，

cues.en: And that's going to be equal to, well, we'll just read that from the environment, like we are everything else, okay?
cues.zh: 值跟其他設定一樣，直接從環境讀取。

cues.en: So I'll call the variable that we're looking for in environment in the .on file, Weaviate host, Weaviate underscore host.
cues.zh: 要在 .env 裡尋找的環境變數，就叫 WEAVIATE_HOST，

cues.en: And I'll give it a sensible default, local host, all right?
cues.zh: 給它合理的預設值 localhost。

cues.en: So we need that.
cues.zh: 這項設定有了，

cues.en: And then I need my trailing comma.
cues.zh: 接著加結尾逗號。

cues.en: And then we're going to have Weaviate HTTP port, Weaviate HTTP port.
cues.zh: 然後是 weaviate_http_port，

cues.en: And that will be equal to, and here we're going to use underscore on underscore int, and that will be Weaviate HTTP port.
cues.zh: 它使用 _env_int，尋找 WEAVIATE_HTTP_PORT，

cues.en: With a default of, we'll just use 8080, okay?
cues.zh: 預設值直接用 8080。

cues.en: And then we want the Weaviate gRPC port.
cues.zh: 接著是 weaviate_grpc_port，

cues.en: And again, it's an underscore on underscore int.
cues.zh: 同樣使用 _env_int，

cues.en: And that will be Weaviate gRPC port.
cues.zh: 尋找 WEAVIATE_GRPC_PORT，

cues.en: Try that again.
cues.zh: 重新輸入一下。

cues.en: And the default for that one will be five, try that again, 50051, okay?
cues.zh: 預設值是五——再打一次，是 50051，

cues.en: With our trailing comma.
cues.zh: 後面加逗號。

cues.en: And we have one more, Weaviate collection.
cues.zh: 最後一項是 weaviate_collection，

cues.en: What are we going to call our collection? Right there.
cues.zh: 集合要叫什麼名字？就在這裡，

cues.en: Well, that'll be just an on underscore on, because it's a string, and we'll call that Weaviate underscore collection.
cues.zh: 因為是字串，使用 _env，環境變數叫 WEAVIATE_COLLECTION，

cues.en: And for a default, we'll call that, I'll just call it PyRegChunk, okay?
cues.zh: 預設值我就命名為 PyRagChunk。

cues.en: We're storing chunks in there, so I'll call it PyRegChunk.
cues.zh: 因為存的是區塊，所以叫 PyRagChunk。

cues.en: Okay, so that sets up our config, simple enough.
cues.zh: 這樣就設定好 Config，很簡單。

cues.en: Now, if I wanted to, I could go over and add these four entries in my .on file, but I've set sensible defaults right here, so I won't bother doing that unless I have to, okay?
cues.zh: 如果想，也能到 .env 新增這四項，但這裡已有合理預設值，除非必要，否則我就不另外寫了。

cues.en: So, we've got our config set up. Let's move on.
cues.zh: 設定完成，我們繼續。
